Lead worker nearer the camera on the right, partly cut by the bottom edge; partner further along the run toward the empty appliance bay. Correct human scale for the cabinet height (worktop at hip height). Lead: short grey hair, navy long-sleeve work shirt, dark trousers, tan leather tool belt, tan boots.
